argv:
set -euo pipefail

export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=4
export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="$PWD"
export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="$PWD/third_party/sglang"
export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2="$PWD/third_party/flashmla"
export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_3=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_3="$PWD/third_party/flashmla/csrc/cutlass"

export GPUS="${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:?GPUQ did not assign GPUs}"
IFS=, read -r -a assigned <<< "$GPUS"
[ "${#assigned[@]}" -eq 4 ]

export CONTAINER=remnant
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_PARENT" ]
[ "$(docker inspect "$CONTAINER" --format "{{.Image}}")" = "$EXPECTED_IMAGE" ]

export SGLANG_ROOT_CT="/mnt/host_root$PWD/third_party/sglang"
export SGLANG_PY="$SGLANG_ROOT_CT/python"
export TP=4 MEM_FRAC=0.86 SERVER_SEED=20260919
export CHUNK=8192 MAX_RUN=256 CTX_LEN=1048576
unset DECODE_CFG SERVER_PID_FILE_CT
unset C4_KEEP_COUNT C4_LAYER_KEEP_COUNTS STORE_IMPLEMENTATION

if [ "$MODE" = kernel ]; then
  export C4_KEEP_COUNT=256
fi

export REPLAY_DIR=/home/jovyan/wenyuhong/benchmarks
export REPLAY_DATASET="$REPLAY_DIR/datasets/h20-dsv4pro/longcodebench_openai"
export REPLAY_MANIFEST="$REPLAY_DIR/cache/official-longswebench/longswebench-openai-v1.json"
export REPLAY_RUNNER="$PWD/scripts/local/business_replay/runner.py"
export REPLAY_ADAPTER="$PWD/scripts/local/business_replay/adapters/openai_sse.py"

export REPLAY_SCHEDULER=fixed-active-user-pool
unset REPLAY_SESSION_POPULATION REPLAY_DRAIN_TIMEOUT REPLAY_TTFT_SLO_MS

export RESULTS_HOST="$PWD/results"
export LOG_HOST="$PWD/logs/$TAG"
export REQUEST_METRICS_DIR="$LOG_HOST/request-metrics"

source scripts/local/eval-env.sh
require_replay_config
python3 scripts/sources.py "$PWD" > "$LOG_HOST/source-manifest.json"
printf "%s\n" "$EXPECTED_IMAGE" > "$LOG_HOST/image-id.txt"
printf "%s\n" "$GPUS" > "$LOG_HOST/gpus.txt"
sha256sum scripts/local/serve.sh scripts/local/run-server.sh \
  scripts/local/bench-lswb.sh > "$LOG_HOST/launcher-sha256.txt"

cleanup() {
  rc=$?
  trap - EXIT INT TERM
  bash scripts/local/serve.sh "$MODE" stop || rc=1
  exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap "exit 130" INT
trap "exit 143" TERM

bash scripts/local/serve.sh "$MODE"

rc=0
bash scripts/local/bench-lswb.sh "$TAG" "$PORT" 24 1200 || rc=$?

shopt -s nullglob
runs=("$RESULTS_HOST/lswb-replay/$TAG"/20*)
[ "${#runs[@]}" -eq 1 ] || {
  echo "Expected exactly one result directory for $TAG"
  exit 1
}
run="${runs[0]}"

mkdir -p "$run/server"
cp "$LOG_HOST/serve_${MODE}.log" \
   "$LOG_HOST/source-manifest.json" \
   "$LOG_HOST/image-id.txt" \
   "$LOG_HOST/gpus.txt" \
   "$LOG_HOST/launcher-sha256.txt" "$run/server/"

bash scripts/local/lswb-row.sh "$run"
printf "Results: %s\n" "$run"
exit "$rc"
